title: See the environmental assessment for each system

steps.text: Environment scores the energy and carbon use of each AI system into an impact tier.
The counts show how many systems are proven, estimated, out of date, failing or not assessed.
Each row shows the latest tier, its confidence, and whether it blocks approval.
Start an assessment opens a form for that system. We will not save it here.
Below the list, a table explains how impact tiers are set. The thresholds are provisional.
